comment: Fork shader routes (Dreams-ShadPS4 v2.64 hashes) and how each was identified on other versions. key = stable dd.shaders entry key (same in 2.52, 2.64, 2.65). doc = DS_ORDERED_COUNT signature (tools/dreams_shader_routes.py). shape_match = signature unique among routes, so it may be used for versions whose code differs. See docs/dreams/VERSIONS.md.

routes.name: Traversal (sculpt traversal, 4 DOC)
routes.evidence: DOC controls+counters = TraversalOrderedControls/CounterIndices; 20 fork trace PCs (0x29c SAVEEXEC, 0x82c CNDMASK->v18, 0x918 CMPX v2, 0xafc/0xb38 V_CMP_NGE, 0xe0c SAVEEXEC, 10 B3-B6 stores 0x1334-0x1548) land on the same instructions in v2.52 49d0daba

routes.name: QueueProducer (primary)
routes.evidence: counter 0x142 = QueueProducerPrimaryOrderedCounterIndex / AdditionalOrderedKernelFor counter 322

routes.name: QueueProducerAlt
routes.evidence: controls 0x0c04/0x140c at base 0x500 = QueueProducerAltOrderedControls

routes.name: CompactClassify
routes.evidence: pack key and 2308-byte code size from the fork's GAME_FILES_INSPECTION; DOC PCs 0x304/0x338 and dispatch 24x1x1 match the fork's capture

routes.name: CompactScatter (stateful radix)
routes.evidence: counter base 0x1e8 = AdditionalOrderedKernelFor(d4532ff4)

routes.name: SelectionListCompact
routes.evidence: counter 0xa40 = SelectionListCompactCounterIndex

routes.name: SceneCompact (1024-thread, 4 DOC per wave)
routes.evidence: controls = SceneCompactOrderedControls, counter base 0x900; local 1024x1x1; fork trace PC 0x9c is S_AND_SAVEEXEC into s6 in v2.52 too

routes.name: IndirectArgs (902)
routes.evidence: row counters 0xa7+row and global 0xa6 = IndirectArgsOrdered*CounterDword

routes.name: VisibilityCandidateCompact (d8, 10-pass radix)
routes.evidence: counter 0x155+pass = VisibilityCandidateOrderedCounterFirstDword

routes.name: GatherInputCompact (95c, 37-pass radix)
routes.evidence: counter 0x5d+pass, pass from SRT word 9 (s9) = GatherInputOrderedCounterFirstDword

routes.name: VisibilityListCompact
routes.evidence: counters 0x15f/0x160 = VisibilityListOrderedCounterIndices

routes.name: VisibilityListCompactAlt
routes.evidence: counters 0x161/0x162 = VisibilityListAltOrderedCounterIndices

routes.name: SculptVolumeWriter (84aa)
routes.evidence: pack key and 1048-byte code size from the fork's GAME_FILES_INSPECTION; counter 0x78 = SculptOrderedCounterIndex

routes.name: B1SeedWriter (4eb)
routes.evidence: pack key and 364-byte code size from the fork's GAME_FILES_INSPECTION; counter 0x79 = B1SeedWriterOrderedCounterIndex; store at fork PC 0x144

routes.name: SculptSurfaceCompact (f030)
routes.evidence: counter 0x100, local 4x4x4; the only 0x100 DOC kernel that samples a volume image (IMAGE_GATHER4_LZ), as 'extracts surface records from the sculpt-density volume'. Signature shared with 5ac: code hash only

routes.name: SculptSurfaceFinalize (5ac)
routes.evidence: counter 0x100, local 4x4x4, dispatched next to f030; three buffer descriptors before GDS (control binding 3). Signature shared with f030: code hash only

routes.name: Alias-proved one-counter compaction (252)
routes.evidence: counter 0x400, direct dispatch, divides by the SRT divisor (V_MUL_HI_U32) as the 252 alias proof expects; its route also requires the audited SPIR-V. Shared signature with fff20d00: code hash only

routes.name: Indirect one-counter compaction (fff2)
routes.evidence: counter 0x400, the indirect 0x400 kernel (fff20d00 is the audited indirect one). Shared signature with 252: code hash only

routes.name: SunShadowPartitionByCascade
routes.evidence: 4 DOC at counter base 0xe4 = AdditionalOrderedKernelFor(6f408bbc)

routes.name: SunShadowPartitionByCascadeSecondPass
routes.evidence: 4 DOC at counter base 0xe8 = AdditionalOrderedKernelFor(a25580f7)

routes.name: SunShadowSortDrawKeys
routes.evidence: radix counter base 0xda = AdditionalOrderedKernelFor(bce8c0fe)

routes.name: Stateful two-counter compaction (4bc)
routes.evidence: 2 DOC at counter base 0x200 = AdditionalOrderedKernelFor(4bc902cf)

routes.name: GatherVoxels (Bricker2GatherVoxelsChunk)
routes.evidence: no DOC; unique v2.52 shader whose code has the fork's 15 trace PCs at the same instructions: 0x180 V_CMP_GE_U32 vs 1023, 0x229c GDS DS_ADD_RTN, B1 stores 0x2278 (v0 row, v1 value) and 0x3c44 (v5 row, v9 value)

routes.name: B1TransformWriter (A3 packed positions)
routes.evidence: no DOC; unique v2.52 shader with the B1 store at fork PC 0x2020 (value v0) and the predicate at 0x1f04

routes.name: A3LookupProducer
routes.evidence: no DOC; unique v2.52 shader (<1 KiB) with the fork's pair/count publications at 0x12c / 0x1ac (BUFFER_ATOMIC_UMAX_X2 / UMAX)

routes.name: ModelFinalize
routes.evidence: no DOC; unique v2.52 shader with V_OR_B32 of v7|v16 at fork PC 0x4d0

routes.name: SpriteCullShader (Subgroup compact atomic inc)
routes.evidence: Massive 74KB culling kernel; 3 unnormalized da=1 IMAGE_SAMPLE_L fetches at pc=11b04/11b88/11b90, DS_APPEND, V_BFE_U32, V_CMP_CLASS_F32, S_ADDK_I32=false

routes.name: SpriteCullShaderAlt (Subgroup compact atomic inc)
routes.evidence: Massive 74KB culling kernel; 3 unnormalized da=1 IMAGE_SAMPLE_L fetches at pc=119b4/11a38/11a40, DS_APPEND, V_BFE_U32, V_CMP_CLASS_F32, S_ADDK_I32=true

routes.name: DreamsSpriteGeometryVertexShaderAlt (Vs370InterfaceCapture)
routes.evidence: VS cuboid proxies; loads 4 transform columns at stride 192 from SRT offset 248, exports POS0, PARAM0, PARAM1 components 0..3

routes.name: DreamsSpriteGeometryVertexShader (Indexed indirect)
routes.evidence: VS indexed indirect geometry; loads transform columns at stride 192 from s[28:29], binds 3 buffers, exports PARAM1 components 0..3

routes.name: DreamsSpriteGeometryFragmentShader
routes.evidence: FS sprite geometry main; interpolates PARAM0.xy and PARAM1.x, loads descriptors at offsets 0x10/0x20/0x30 from s[13:14], exports to MRT0 and depth (target 8)

routes.name: DreamsSculptFragmentShader (Ce3ReadConst)
routes.evidence: FS sculpt atlas raymarching; sole FS with V_BFE_U32 + S_ADDK_I32 + V_CMP_CLASS_F32, dynamic SMRD loads from s[0:1] + SGPR2*16 + 96

routes.name: DreamsFleckDecodeFragmentShader
routes.evidence: FS fleck decode; sole FS with V_AND_B32 0x7fffff tag 2 unpacking and dynamic constants at offset 96 (0x60)

routes.name: PrimGlassMipBlurDownCS (Glass mip)
routes.evidence: Glass mip builder; sole CS with exactly 4 2D unnormalized explicit LOD IMAGE_SAMPLE_L followed by IMAGE_STORE

routes.name: SunShadowMipCascade0
routes.evidence: CS sun shadow mip 0; da=1 explicit LOD IMAGE_SAMPLE_L, V_BFE_U32=true, V_CMP_CLASS_F32=false

routes.name: SunShadowMipCascade1
routes.evidence: CS sun shadow mip 1; da=1 explicit LOD IMAGE_SAMPLE_L, V_BFE_U32=true, V_CMP_CLASS_F32=false

routes.name: ShadowHeightPyramidProducer
routes.evidence: CS shadow height pyramid; 4 da=1 IMAGE_SAMPLE_L fetches followed by IMAGE_STORE_MIP

routes.name: SpotShadowMipOccluders
routes.evidence: CS spot shadow occluders; 4 da=1 IMAGE_SAMPLE_L fetches followed by IMAGE_STORE_MIP

routes.name: Array2dLodSelector
routes.evidence: CS array LOD selector; DS_APPEND, 3 unnormalized da=1 IMAGE_SAMPLE_L fetches, V_CMP_CLASS_F32=true, V_BFE_U32=false

routes.name: Array2dLodMip
routes.evidence: CS array LOD mip; explicit LOD da=1 IMAGE_SAMPLE_L at pc=010c followed by IMAGE_STORE_MIP at pc=0148

routes.name: TemporalResolveShader
routes.evidence: CS temporal resolve; LDS memory barrier target, 19 SOP2 live-mask operations matching scalar_alu.cpp:385

routes.name: SpatialReconstructionPrepareShader
routes.evidence: CS spatial reconstruction prepare; post-fill LDS barrier target, reads raw image tiles, branch loop LDS write at pc=0174..01a4

routes.name: SpatialReconstructionShader
routes.evidence: CS spatial reconstruction; post-fill LDS barrier target, 8 LDS writes in branch loop, V_CMP_CLASS_F32=true, V_BFE_U32=false

routes.name: GpuScalarTableReadCamera
routes.evidence: CS camera table read; nested SRT pointer from root 2 (s[2:3]), 112 SMRD table reads, no LDS instructions, V_CMP_CLASS_F32=true
